events.name: The Milk Carton Kids w/ Paper Wings
SALIN with Midpak
events.info: Soul'd Out Presents: Salin w/ Midpak Doors : 7:00pm Show : 8:00pm Ages 21+. Salin is a Thai-born drummer, Juno-nominated producer, and composer. She was chosen to be one of the 6 artists of CBC's Revelation Canada (2025) and has been featured on the cover of Tidal's Best New Jazz and Spotify's Fresh Finds Jazz playlists. Her newly released album , "rdquo" -> Rammana" is a groundbreaking album that merges afro-jazz, funk, and indigenous Thai instruments, forming a new sub-genre that Salin calls , "rdquo" -> Afro Thai Funk". This unique blend highlights shared global music traditions and reminds us that music is a universal language, transcending borders and uniting us all in a shared experience of joy and creativity. Through her music, she ponders themes of identity, spirituality, and humanity, all paired with a dose of fun to create a unique sonic journey for her listeners. Coming out of Seattle, Washington, Midpak is an instrumental funk-fueled psychedelic experience. With influences ranging from 70's funk to global grooves, and no fear of electronica, Midpak has created a new unique sound, and they're eager to share.

events.name: NICK MOSS BAND feat. Jason Ricci
events.info: Since first forming The Nick Moss Band in 2016, master blues guitarist Nick Moss has been a torchbearer for traditional electric blues. But rather than simply repeating whats come before, the bands high-energy take on old school Chicago, Texas and West Coast sounds is completely their own. AllMusic says the band, winners of the 2020 makes the case for the vitality of old-fashioned Chicago electric blues in the 21st century. They are among the worlds very best old school blues ensembles, with each musician expertly playing off the others. We are a rare breed as far as how authentic we like to keep the music, while also keeping it up-to-date and exciting, says Moss.Among many awards and recognitions the band has received, Nick Moss garnered the 2019 Blues Music Award for Best Traditional Blues Male Artist. The band took home Blues Music Awards in 2020 for Album of the Year, Song of the Year, and Band of the Year. In 2024 the band received the prestigious Band of the Year honors again from the Blues Music Awards. Nick Moss proudly represents the city of Chicago as one of the few bluesmen working today to have learned his craft firsthand, directly from many of the genres original creatorsand rest assured that the band will bring you the best in authentic Blues!---JLR Seating Map Notes: For this show, you may reserve individual tables on the map pictured. events.name: The Menzingers w/ Hot Water Music
CHUCK ISRAELS JAZZ ORCH - Jazz Titan Thursdays
events.info: CHUCK ISRAELS JAZZ ORCH - Jazz Titan ThursdaysChuck Israels, revered as one of the preeminent bassists in the world, GRAMMY winner has performed and recorded with Billie Holiday, Benny Goodman, Herbie Hancock, John Coltrane, Bud Powell, Coleman Hawkins, Stan Getz, Bill Evans, J.J. Johnson, Rosemary Clooney, Tony Williams, Eric Dolphy, Jim Hall, Patti Austin, Gary Burton, George Russell, the Kronos String Quartet, and countless others. Among Chuck's many recordings as a bassist, some outstanding ones include: Coltrane Time, with John Coltrane; My Point of View, with Herbie Hancock; Getz au Go-Go, with Stan Getz; and many recordings with the Bill Evans Trio, including The Town Hall Concert; The Second Trio; Trio '65; Live at the Trident; and Time Remembered. In 2020 Chuck won a GRAMMY for his work with opera star Joyce DiDonato on her recording "Songplay" As an acclaimed composer and arranger, Chuck has written for Bill Evans, John Coltrane, Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis, Berkshire Music Center, Richard Stoltzman, Eastman Jazz Ensemble, Swedish Radio Jazz Orchestra, West German Radio Jazz Orchestra, North German Radio Jazz Orchestra, Radio Denmark Jazz Orchestra, Hannover Symphony Orchestra, Metropole Orchestra, and others. JAZZ TITAN THURSDAYS The Jack London Revue proudly presents Jazz Titan Thursdays, featuring the Mel Brown B3 Organ Group and the Chuck Israels Jazz Orchestra. Join us at Portland's top jazz club to honor two of the most influential names in Pacific Northwest jazz music: Mel Brown - drummer for Marvin Gaye, Diana Ross, Stevie Wonder, and the Temptations and Chuck Israels - bassist for Billie Holiday, Benny Goodman, Herbie Hancock, and Bill Evans. This Thursday, immerse yourself in the speakeasy vibe and rich sound of live soul, jazz, and bebop. Two sets starting at 7pm. Enjoy our full bar and menu. General admission and table packages available. JLR Seating Map Notes: For this show, you may reserve individual tables on the map pictured. Note that some tables have limited sightlines as noted.
